CHECK a (behaviour x geometry fidelity). Goal: find one connected pathway using the training-only successor weights and a curved operation. Read: tree files train_rqvae.py (466 lines), model/model.py (50), model/layers.py (296), model/utils.py (380), model/__init__.py (6); greps for utils|HVector|HResidual|poincare|frechet|successor|indeg|transition|weight|clip|expmap|logmap|kappa|curvature. Observation: train_rqvae.py imports only `from model import RQVAE` (line 37); model/__init__.py exports only layers.py/model.py classes; model/layers.py is the unmodified Euclidean VQ/RQ stack (VQLayer._distances lines 98-104, quant_loss F.mse_loss line 132, straight-through line 133). VQ_TYPE='vq' (train_rqvae.py:80) selects VQLayer (layers.py:262-263). The only hyperbolic code is model/utils.py (poincare_distance:55, expmap0:42, logmap0:49, HVectorQuantization:162, HResidualVectorQuantization:279), which is never imported anywhere (grep 'from .utils'/'import utils' = 0 hits; HResidualVectorQuantization referenced only inside utils.py). No transition counting, no indeg, no n_v, no w_v, no clip [0.25,4], no batch weight normalisation, no Fréchet/codebook estimator step anywhere in the tree. Conclusion: (a) FAIL, blocking: inherited unused hyperbolic helper + unchanged Euclidean quantizer; no behaviour signal at all. Nothing to exercise; this is the baseline RQ-VAE source. Open: nothing.

CHECK b (trainability / coupling switch). Goal: does a real forward+backward exercise the coupled behaviour+geometry term, and do behaviour-off / Euclidean switches change it? Read train_rqvae.py:316-330 (batch loop: model(batch) -> raw_module.compute_loss -> loss.backward -> clip -> AdamW), model/model.py:26-50 (forward, compute_loss = recon_loss + quant_loss), model/layers.py:98-134 and 273-290. Observation: the only differentiable path is encoder MLP -> RQLayer -> VQLayer Euclidean distances -> F.embedding -> MSE quant_loss/straight-through; codebook embed.weight is a plain nn.Parameter updated by AdamW. There is no successor weight tensor, no weighted commitment, no exp/log map, no Fréchet codebook update, no curvature constant and no on/off switch in any exercised path. The proposal's three switches (behaviour-off, geometry-off/Euclidean, both-on) do not exist, so the SID assignment and gradients cannot change when the coupling is switched on. The hyperbolic helpers in model/utils.py are dead code: HVectorQuantization.forward (lines 224-276) is never called, and RQLayer (layers.py:238-271) can only construct VQLayer/EMAVQLayer/SimVQLayer. Conclusion: (b) FAIL, blocking. Baseline Euclidean forward/backward is finite-looking (loss finite-guarded at train_rqvae.py:322), but the proposed mechanism is entirely missing, so there is no coupled term to be trainable and no dead-vs-live question beyond the dead utils.py. Open: nothing.

CHECK c (integration). Goal: entry point, frozen data path, SID export/indexing, result-dir scoping, launcher incl. single-card. Read train_rqvae.py:42-67 (repo root, ARM_NAME, RESULT_DIR, data/output paths), 232-271 (DDP init, data load, sampler), 386-429 (checkpoint + SID export), 436-466 (launcher delegation); logs/training_metrics.jsonl; model/layers.py export helper use. SID rows are produced by get_indices(all_embeddings) in embedding-row order, _extend_collisions (195-208) only rewrites the 4th token within a collision group using offsets cumsum([0,256,256,256]), uniqueness is asserted (422-423), np.save + json payload keyed by enumerate(sid) (425-427) therefore indexes item_id == embedding row. The conformance run wrote to results/stage2_RQ-VAE/_conformance/TIGER_RQ-VAE/..., not to the literal ARM_NAME value on line 58 (TIGER_RQ-VAE), which shows the executing copy receives the harness arm name at copy time (as the comment on line 57 says); RESULT_DIR is results/stage2_RQ-VAE/<arm>, i.e. under the repository. LOG_DIR is REPO_ROOT/stage2_RQ-VAE/<arm>/logs, inside the executing arm's own source copy, not another arm. Launcher: _launch_via_torchrun delegates world size/port to tools.research.stage2.launcher (448-460) and the file itself has no GENREC_SINGLE_GPU reference; the single-card path is therefore owned by the frozen shared launcher, and the conformance world_size=1 run demonstrates that branch executes. Conclusion: (c) PASS, no blocking integration defect found. STEP: read model/frechet_poincare.py, model/layers.py, model/model.py, train_rqvae.py (all fully). Observations:
A) coupled path exists: layers.py:140-149 curved branch (point=exp_0(latent), weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids), cost=poincare_distance, argmin, remember); layers.py:164-168 commitment uses same weights+poincare distance; model.py:40-62 calls layer.frechet.step; frechet_poincare.py:121-154 weighted tangent Frechet step with log_at/exp_at. Both behaviour and curvature are required there, so a connected pathway exists and the trainer wires it (train_rqvae.py:246 frechet_codebook, 319-322 set_weights, 423 apply_frechet_codebook_step).
B) candidate blocking defects found so far:
  1. clamp_ball() at frechet_poincare.py:35-38 does not clamp, it unconditionally rescales every input to norm 1-eps. It is called by exp_at:51, log_at:56, log_0:65, poincare_distance:73-74. So every encoder point and every codebook entry is forced to the r=0.999 shell inside all geometry; radial order is erased (poincare_distance(clamp tests) maps 0.1*e1 and 0.5*e1 to the same point => distance 0 instead of 0.898). The correct conditional projection exists in model/utils.py:21-28 (torch.where(norm>max_norm,...)).
  2. trainer switch wiring train_rqvae.py:246 frechet_codebook=USE_BEHAVIOUR and USE_GEOMETRY means USE_GEOMETRY=False builds no FrechetCodebook at all, so behaviour-off and geometry-off are the same baseline arm; the internal Euclidean branches in FrechetCodebook.distances:113-118 / step:147-150 are unreachable from the trainer. The three-switch requirement is not met.
  3. distributed: apply_frechet_codebook_step (model.py:40-62) writes .data of embed.weight, which is a DDP parameter; it is rank-local (own shard's _last) and there is no broadcast/all_reduce afterwards (train_rqvae.py:420-423, DDP at 333 with broadcast_buffers=False). On 4 cards the codebooks diverge across ranks.
  4. spec deviation: codebook is still gradient-trained: layers.py:166 commitment is not sg on c and layers.py:167 has the ordinary mse(x_q, x.detach()) codebook loss; embed.weight is in optimizer (train_rqvae.py:368). Proposal says codebook update must be replaced by the detached Frechet estimator.
Still open: weight construction details (self-transitions, tail(1) per user, per-batch normalization missing), SID export/indexing, launcher/single-GPU branch, cost.
